notes.title: Cook-Out Patch 1.15.1 - Error Tracking
notes.content:
Hello Cook-Out fans!

To make it easier for the dev team to pinpoint the cause of issues in the game going forward, this patch [b]1.15.1[/b] adds additional error tracking to the game. 

Please submit a support request to us https://resolutiongames.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new if you face any issues in the game, to make it easier for our dev team to help you and improve the game.

[list]
[*] Added additional error tracking.
[*] Fixed player rotation being offset slightly to the left after recentering.
[*] Fixed Spender achievement not being awarded on Steam.
[*] Fixed French being used instead of Spanish in the user reporting menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Can't start Cook-Out through Steam Link? — Here's a fix!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682354/075dcaff78eaf25b8b182fadcb1724382d422dbc.png[/img]

If you're using Steam Link on any of the Meta Quest headsets and can't get Cook-Out past the "Next Up" step on the headset (see the screenshot above), so that it only runs on your main monitor, the cause is likely that you don't have SteamVR set as you current OpenXR runtime. This post will give you some background on this issue and show you how to fix it.

[h2]Background[/h2]
Cook-Out uses OpenXR which means that it can and will run with any OpenXR runtime on your computer. Which runtime is used can't be controlled by the game. Rather, whatever runtime is set as the current OpenXR on your computer will be used.

The Oculus PC client will give you an explicit warning if it isn't set as your current OpenXR runtime, with a button to set is as such. Hence, most Quest users using the Quest with their PC will most likely have Oculus set as their current OpenXR runtime.

This is fine when running the game using Meta Quest Link as it will work with both the Oculus client and SteamVR. Steam Link only works with SteamVR however which means that you will need to set SteamVR as your current OpenXR runtime instead.

[h2]How to fix[/h2]
To set SteamVR as you current OpenXR runtime, you must:

1. Run [b]SteamVR[/b]

2. In the [b]STEAMVR[/b] window on your computer, click [b]≡[/b] in the upper left corner followed by [b]Settings[/b] in the dropdown:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682354/50dc2ba2adf5bc0983673121f19f01e38c8e9a55.png[/img]

3. In the [b]SteamVR Settings[/b] window, go to the [b]OpenXR[/b] tab and click [b]SET STEAMVR AS OPENXR RUNTIME[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682354/b9cb3e204fa6212e61f447717ebf19ae8b223906.png[/img]

(For older versions of SteamVR, this option can instead be found under the [b]Developer[/b] tab after clicking [b]Show[/b] under [b]Advanced Settings[/b])

[h2]Result[/h2]
When SteamVR is set as your current OpenXR runtime, your SteamVR settings should look as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682354/d1b73fc6d5092d4c478faff6c50443735d3abbd2.png[/img]

At this point, you should be able to start the game using Steam Link without any issues.

If you ever set Oculus or any other OpenXR runtime as you current OpenXR runtime after this, you will need to revisit this guide to set SteamVR as your current OpenXR runtime again before you can run Cook-Out through Steam Link again.

notes.title: Temporary Patch Reversion — Lost Progress Hotfix — Permanent Fix in the Works
notes.content:
This patch reverts the previous patch from last week (https://steamcommunity.com/games/1523720/announcements/detail/3747617344196555415) completely.

As reported by users, the previous patch resulted in seemingly lost in-game progress, for which we are deeply sorry.

We can confirm however that all save data still remains intact; the location where it's stored has simply changed. We have therefore released this temporary reversion patch to allow you to access your old save from before the previous patch again. Any save data from after said patch is however unavailable now instead.

Thank you all for your patience!

Dear Chefs,

this update contains mainly a couple of minor bug fixes, which together should create a more stable experience.

Good luck cooking!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.14
notes.content:
Hi Chefs,

We have added in-game user reporting. You can access the option from a button in the wrist menu in multiplayer session which will show a list of users participating. In case of misbehavior, select a user and follow the quick steps for reporting.

Exiting the multiplayer session will preserve the list of users participating which means that you can report a user after the session has ended.

We wish you an even happier cooking!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.13
notes.content:
Hi Chefs,

We released a game patch that will enhance your experience when interacting with players on different platforms. You can also now manually adjust your hand position to better match your controllers. Please update your app for the changes to apply.

We can’t wait to ketchup with you in the Cook-Out kitchen.

Happy cooking!
